text.tspan: Film one swing down the line. AIcoach tells you
what a good coach would: what the fault is, where
it comes from, how sure it is of every step, and
what to practise next session.
A practice tool for golfers from +2 to 15 handicap. One swing clip from
your phone, mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds.
Example result with synthetic data: Rory, 34, 11 handicap, a 7-iron filmed at 120 fps at the range after work.

svg.text: Route from likely cause to fault

text.tspan: It may feel like you stay down, but
at impact your hips have moved
toward the ball.

svg.text: Mobility: generic guidance, not medical advice.
Answers come only from this analysis

text.tspan: “Why does it feel like I'm staying down when I'm not?”
Your upper body stays fairly level, so it feels
like staying down. The impact key frame shows
what moved: your hips, 7% of your body height
toward the ball.

svg.text: It says when it can't see.

text.tspan: Feel and reality often disagree in golf, and
practising the wrong fix grooves the fault. So
AIcoach marks its map like a surveyor: what was
measured, what is only pointed to, and what it could
not see at all.
A face-on view, feet out of frame or under 30 fps: the swing clip is rejected,
never guessed at. Each reason links to the filming guide step that fixes it.
If none of the three faults in the rule table is there, it says so instead of
forcing one onto your swing.
Anything outside the rule table is marked unverified, with its confidence and no
drill.

svg.text: A confidence band on every measurement

text.tspan: High, medium or low, drawn the same way everywhere. Clips under 120 fps never get
high.

svg.text: Four stops between the phone in your bag and the next ball you hit.

text.tspan: Prop the phone at hand height on your
bag, 2.4–3.7 m behind you on the hands
line. Down the line, whole body and
club in frame, one swing.
Upload the swing clip from your phone
browser: mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds.
Saving it to your swing library is
your choice.
The fault, the route that led to it,
how sure AIcoach is of each link, and
key frames with body lines drawn.
One drill and one mobility exercise
for the rest of the bucket. Film again
next session and compare.

svg.text: Three faults, decided by a rule table.

text.tspan: The MVP checks every swing clip for exactly these three. Each has a fixed measurement, cause, drill and
mobility exercise. Anything else is marked unverified.
Hips move toward the ball from
address to impact
Restricted hip rotation
Wall drill
90/90 hip rotation
Posture angle change in the downswing
vs address
Weak hip hinge or tight
hamstrings
Alignment-stick head
drill
Hip-hinge / hamstring
mobility
Capped at medium confidence:
measured from the hand path.
Hand path in transition above the
backswing path
Upper body starts the
downswing
Pump drill
Open books
Email and password. Your swing clips stay private, and you can
delete any analysis or your whole account at any time.

svg.text: AIcoach is a practice tool, not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
